title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. The pages study the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli spaces M_{g,ν}. The ambient space is the stable compactification. Θ is its boundary divisor, which has normal crossings. D_d denotes the (normalized) boundary stratum of codimension d. For a decreasing sequence d_* = (d_0 > d_1 > ... > d_r), D_{d_*} is the space of nested strata (flags of sets of branches/nodes). (223), on the previous page, gives the forgetful map D_{d_*} → D_{d'_*}, which drops the first index (d'_* = (d_1, ..., d_r), d'_0 = d_1). Each D_{d'_*} carries the induced normal-crossings divisor Θ_{d'_*}, pulled back from the boundary. Θ^{(p)}_{d'_*} is its codimension-p skeleton (points where at least p local branches meet). Θ^{(p)*}_{d'_*} is the open part where exactly p branches meet.

This page.
(226) Defines Θ^{d_*}_{d'_*}: the skeleton coming from the codimension d = d_0 − d'_0 part of Θ_{d'_*} inside D_{d'_*}.
Then: the map (225) induces a local isomorphism of D_{d_*} onto that skeleton. More precisely:
(227) D_{\tilde d'_*} ≅ Θ^{(d)}_{d'_*}, with \tilde d'_* = (d_0, d'_0, ..., d'_r). This is the flag space with the extra top index inserted.
(228) Restricting gives an isomorphism of open parts, D^*_{\tilde d'_*} ≅ Θ^{(d)*}_{d'_*}.
(229) The map D_{d_*} → D_{d'_*} factors as D_{d_*} → D_{\tilde d'_*} ≅ Θ^{(d)}_{d'_*} ⊂ D_{d'_*}. The first map is finite étale (a choice of ordering/labeling of branches); the second is the 'inclusion' of the skeleton. D^*_{d_*} is the inverse image of D^*_{\tilde d'_*}, i.e. of Θ^{(d)*}_{d'_*}.

Purpose. This inductive bookkeeping reduces the nested-stratum situation to the 'situation clef' on the next page. That situation is a smooth analytic Y with a normal-crossings divisor Θ, a chain of local immersions D''^* → D'^* → Y factoring through skeleta, and the multinormal principal bundles P_{D''}, P_{D'} with their groupoids. In other words, it sets up a description of punctured tubular neighbourhoods of boundary strata, i.e. the fundamental groupoid at infinity.
errors: (227) is written as an isomorphism D_{\tilde d'_*} ≅ Θ^{(d)}_{d'_*}. A codimension-d skeleton of a normal-crossings divisor is not normal where more than d branches meet. So this can only be literally true if Θ^{(d)} denotes the normalized skeleton (disjoint union of local branch intersections); otherwise the map is the normalization, a local immersion. The page's own wording 'isomorphisme local' supports the normalization reading. The open-part statement (228) is correct as written.

Index notation is inconsistent: in (226) the superscripts are d_*, d, d_1, and the relation between d'_0 and d_1 is unclear. The mathematical content (insert d_0 at the top of the flag) is nevertheless clear from (227).

ideas.what: Stratification of the boundary of the compactified moduli space by nested strata. A flag-stratum maps finite étale onto the open stratum of the induced normal-crossings divisor on a coarser stratum.
ideas.modern_name: Boundary stratification of \bar M_{g,n} by stable graphs and graph contractions; normalizations of strata closures
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne–Mumford (1969), Knudsen (1983); standard in later work (e.g. Arbarello–Cornalba–Griffiths)
ideas.where_published: Only allusively in Esquisse d'un programme (structure at infinity, Teichmüller tower)

ideas.what: Skeleta Θ^{(p)} and open skeleta Θ^{(p)*} of a normal-crossings divisor, with nested-flag spaces D_{d_*} parametrizing chains.
ideas.modern_name: Stratification by number of local branches; normal-crossings/log stratification
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (Deligne, Hodge II, 1971, for normal-crossings combinatorics)

ideas.what: Preparation for 'multinormal principal bundles' and groupoids of local immersions into Y along Θ (next page). These model punctured tubular neighbourhoods of strata.
ideas.modern_name: Deleted tubular neighbourhoods / Kato–Nakayama real oriented boundary; torus bundles of the normal-crossings normal bundles
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kato–Nakayama (1999); also Harer, Ivanov, Looijenga for moduli of curves

deep.surprise_reason: This page is routine combinatorial bookkeeping about nested boundary strata of a normal-crossings compactification. It contains no new result, only preparation for the multinormal-bundle construction on the following page.
transcription_corrections: Margin of (226): 'spécialité [?] provient de [?] [?] de Θ_{d'_*}' should read roughly 'squelette provenant de la codim. d de Θ_{d'_*} dans D_{d'_*}'.
'et on [?] donc induit un iso' is likely 'il en est donc induit un iso'.
(226) left side: the crossed-out superscript is followed by d_*, i.e. Θ^{d_*}_{d'_*} := Θ^{d}_{d'_*} ∩ Θ^{d_1}_{d'_*} as written (the last superscript is uncertain).
